narrative.rotation_signal: Institutions are accumulating mega-cap tech (MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN), payments (V/MA), pharma leaders (LLY/ABBV), financials (JPM/MS), and semicap (AMAT/TXN) while distributing energy (XOM), legacy tech (INTC/CSCO/IBM), and select semis (AVGO/LRCX). The split is sharp — 25 bullish vs 12 bearish/lean-bearish — indicating high-conviction stock-picking rather than broad index buying.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: AVGO and LRCX bearish here despite broad semi strength elsewhere (AMAT/TXN bullish) — semicap is bifurcating. PLTR lean-bearish diverges from typical momentum-tech bullishness. JNJ bearish while pharma peers LLY/ABBV are full bullish — pharma is name-specific, not sector-wide.
